title: BNCI 2025-001 Motor Kinematics Reaching dataset
description: This dataset comprises preprocessed electroencephalography (EEG) recordings from 20 healthy participants performing a four-direction center-out reaching task with varying movement speeds and distances. Participants executed discrete reaching movements in response to visual cues while maintaining eye fixation, with 16 distinct motor imagery classes defined by direction (up, down, left, right), speed (slow, fast), and distance (near, far). The dataset includes 67 EEG channels recorded at 500 Hz with comprehensive preprocessing including artifact correction, ICA decomposition, and source localization analysis.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a BrainAmp system with 67 channels at 500 Hz sampling rate. Preprocessing included low-pass filtering at 100 Hz, 50 Hz notch filtering, downsampling to 200 Hz, bad channel rejection and interpolation, bandpass filtering (0.3-80 Hz), eye artifact correction via SGEYESUB, ICA with FastICA algorithm, IC artifact removal, and common average reference. Frontal channels and EOG were removed prior to common average reference. Bad trials were rejected based on amplitude thresholds (>200 µV) or statistical criteria (>5 SD), and movement-related trials were rejected for incorrect direction, absence of movement, or abnormal movement duration.
